name: Tsukigata (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Tsukigata town emblem in white: a cogwheel-like hexagon enclosing a disc with a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Tsukigata, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 30 September 1940.

features.role: Tsukigata town emblem — a cogwheel-like hexagon enclosing a disc with a stylised character
